name: Phosphor / Terminal
look: Green vector strokes and a typing pixel-font terminal on a CRT carrier; plate B is an oscilloscope

axes.base: near-black green screen with a soft lift at the centre
axes.line: constant-width glowing vector strokes; pixel-grid sprites and text
axes.tone: no fills or hatching; brightness is the only tone: dim, lit, hot
axes.planB: the vector plate: oscilloscope traces and wireframes on the same screen
axes.motion: text types on the frame; traces sweep at 24 fps; sprites step on twos
axes.carrier: crt: scanlines, a rounded screen, a slow hum bar, faint flicker
axes.accent: amber, for one alert per act
axes.match: a trace or a sprite keeps its place across a cut; acts end on crtoff
axes.overlays: scales, graticules and readouts in the pixel font
